summary: Level 1-220 (+ AI title levels 1-30 + LE research) leveling path, hunting spots and key quests for the Soldier (profession 1), written for AOBuddy10. The Soldier has NO pet, NO real heal (two DrainHeal nanos) and NO crowd control. It levels by holding the biggest Assault Rifle its skills allow and keeping a stack of reflect and absorb nanos up. That makes the whole leveling curve a race between two numbers: the weapon skills that let you hold the next gun, and the Matter Creation / Time & Space that let you cast the next shield. Both of those are read out of the client data below, not from a guide - every nano level gate comes from soldier-nanos.json and every weapon/armour requirement from items.ocp. Where you actually go to kill things is class-agnostic; those windows come from Faffy's AO Levelling Chart (a local file) and the AODB Hunting Grounds page.

professionMechanicsThatShapeLeveling: TWO SKILL TRACKS, ALWAYS. Assault Rifle / Burst / Full Auto / Ranged Init. decide what you can hold; Matter Creation (cost 2.5) and Time & Space (cost 3.2) decide what shield you can cast. Matter Creation is a cast requirement on 102 of the Soldier's 177 nanos and Time & Space on 64. Letting the nano pair fall behind is the classic mistake - you end up with a gun you cannot survive behind.

THE REFLECT LADDER IS FLAT AT THE BOTTOM AND STEEP AT THE TOP. Total Mirror Shield Mk I needs only MC 58 / TS 46, so a Soldier has 75% reflect from single digits. Mk X needs MC 695 / TS 590. Then nothing until Augmented Mirror Shield MK I at LEVEL 175 (MC 914 / TS 880). Plan for a long plateau between ~level 60 and 175 where your reflect does not improve - your armour and HP have to.

THE SHADOWLANDS REFLECT LINE IS THE REAL PROGRESSION. The 'Empowered ...' / Resonance line (strain 694) unlocks at levels 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 145 / 155 / 175 / 185 / 201 / 207 / 212 / 220 and STACKS with a mirror shield (different strain). One cast covers you and the team. If you own Shadowlands, buy the next tier the level you reach it.

SPECIALIZATION BITS GATE MOST SOLDIER NANOS. The weapon buffs, the team damage line and the detaunts all carry 'Specialization op22 1/2/4/8' in their cast requirements. Specialization 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 are quest rewards, so the quest track is not optional for a Soldier the way it is for some classes.
NO HEAL MEANS STIMS AND PULL DISCIPLINE. The entire heal kit is Don't Fear the Reaper (29241) and Adrenaline Rush (301897), both tiny DrainHeals. Budget first aid kits and stims at every level.
SINGLE-TARGET AGGRO ONLY. The 20 taunts and 6 detaunts are all single-target. A Soldier can hold one mob, not a camp. Pull one at a time.

THE PERENNIUM BLASTER GIVES XP. Perennium Blaster (246422-246427, QL50-199) and Rebuilt Perennium Blaster (260700-260705) carry 'XPModifier +3' as a WORN bonus, and the Superior versions (246428 / 260706, QL200) carry +4. Verified in items.ocp. It is Soldier-only, needs Shadowlands, and wants Assault Rifle 996 / Burst 747 / Full Auto 897 - a genuine twink target because it makes every kill worth more.

froobVsPaid: FROOB (free play = Classic Rubi-Ka + free Notum Wars): hard cap level 200, NO Shadowlands, NO Alien Invasion, NO Lost Eden. That is unusually painful for a Soldier because of what the client data shows is gated: EVERY tier of the weapon-buff family (A Sergeant's Knowledge, Art of Peace, the Metal Stream -> Soldier Clip Junkie Full Auto ladder, Alleysweeper -> Swiss Cheese, Artillery Fire -> Battery Fire, Power Volley -> The Power of Three) carries 'Expansion op22 2' AND a Specialization bit, so a froob Soldier cannot cast a single one of them. The whole 'Fight (Team)' team damage line is Shadowlands-only too, as is every 'Empowered' team reflect, every Augmented Mirror Shield, the Perennium Blaster and all of the Tier armour. A froob Soldier's buff kit is therefore: the Total Mirror Shield line (70300-70309), the Absorption Shield / Combat Barrier line (75401-75413, 29223), Assault Rifle Mastery 29220 (+60), Riot Control 29251 (+110 Burst), Rifle/Pistol/Ranged Energy Mastery, Total Focus 29255, Automatic Targeting 29222, Precognition 29247, Offensive Steamroller 29240 and the Body Boost -> Battlefield Endurance HP line. That is still a complete, functional class - a froob Soldier has 75% reflect from level 10 and the best AC buffs on Rubi-Ka - but it plateaus at Total Mirror Shield Mk X and never gets a Full Auto buff. Best froob gear: the Division 9 Plasmaprojector line (Soldier-only, no expansion gate) and Notum Infused Kevlar Armor (Soldier-only, level 180+, no expansion gate). PAID (SL) unlocks the heckler/garden highway, the entire weapon-buff family, the Empowered reflect line and levels 201-220. PAID (AI) adds the AXP track, the two procs (Title Level 4+ / 6+) and Combined armour. PAID (LE) adds research, Battlestations/Victory Points and the whole Ofab Soldier set.
tips: Train Matter Creation and Time & Space alongside Assault Rifle, not after it. 102 of your 177 nanos check Matter Creation and 64 check Time & Space. A Soldier who only trains the gun has no reflect, and reflect is the class.
Total Mirror Shield Mk I costs almost nothing (MC 58 / TS 46) - have a 75% reflect running from single digits. Nothing else in the game gives a level-10 character that.

Expect a reflect plateau from about level 60 to 175: after Total Mirror Shield Mk X there is NO new self-reflect until Augmented Mirror Shield MK I at level 175. Bridge it with the Shadowlands Empowered line (which stacks, different strain) and with armour/Body Dev.

Body Dev. costs 1.1 for a Soldier - the second-cheapest skill in the whole 69-skill table and cheaper than for any profession except the Enforcer. Max it; the reflect layer is spread over that HP pool.
Pull ONE mob at a time. All 20 taunts and all 6 detaunts are single-target, and you cannot heal. A Soldier holds one target, not a camp.
Learn the detaunts as they unlock (Bypass Me 75, Circumvent Me 145, Elude Me 195, Keep Clear of Me 207, Shake Off Me 214, Desist Me 219). With no heal, shedding aggro IS your emergency button.
Buy the next Specialization as soon as it is available - Specialization bits 1/2/4/8 are literal cast requirements on the weapon buffs, the team damage line and the detaunts, not just a power bump.
Get a Perennium Blaster as early as your skills allow (Assault Rifle 996 / Burst 747 / Full Auto 897, Shadowlands, Soldier only). XPModifier +3 means it pays for the twinking effort in XP.
Do TotW completely before level 60 - entry hard-locks and several of the best low-level items are in there.
Loot the Ring of the Nucleus Basalis from Abmouth early. NCU is a real constraint for a Soldier: self reflect + team reflect + weapon buff + Full Auto buff + HP + damage + init all at once.

Get a Trader wrangle before every equip step. It raises the weapon skills (hold the next gun, cap the next special) and the nano skills (cast the next shield) in one cast - the single most efficient outside help a Soldier can get.

From 60 up, chase heckler teams. You bring a team reflect, a team AC buff (Phalanx, which stacks with everything) and a team damage buff - that makes a Soldier a wanted team member, not just a DPS slot.
At 205, drop everything and do Dust Brigade 1. The Soldier Nanodeck is worth more than any other single item in the game to this class - six of your best nanos do not exist without it.
Carry stims and first-aid kits at every level. Your entire heal kit is two DrainHeal nanos.
Grind AI levels in city defence: it is the safest AXP for a class with no heal, and Title Level 4 and 6 unlock your only two procs.

Faffy's chart trick for the 81-156 band: when you pull the 'Extraction' or 'A Contingent Spy' daily, grind the mobs inside it, respawning them by exiting and re-entering, and do NOT complete the mission until you are done for the day.

The 'DOJA chip', 'mini XP', 'DM-XP' and 'LotV' shorthand is Faffy's chart's own terminology and is reproduced as-is. It is not expanded or interpreted here.

Faffy's chart is a froob-oriented guide ('Faffy's Anarchy Online Froob Guide'), so its Rubi-Ka windows are tuned for characters without expansions. The Shadowlands rows are present and used, but a paid Soldier will outrun several RK windows.

Token board / tokens, the Battlestation Victory Point rates and the exact 220 checklist numbers (84k VP, QL240+ symbiants) are carried from soldier-endgame.json, which cites the athenpaladins progress guide - they are community targets, not hard requirements.

Level windows from the AODB Hunting Grounds page and from Faffy's chart disagree by a few levels in several places (e.g. Dark Ruins Solo: AODB 160-180 vs Faffy 150-170). Both numbers are given rather than picking one.

No claim is made about which spot is FASTEST for a Soldier specifically - the spot windows are class-agnostic. The class-specific content in this file is the nano/weapon/armour gate timeline, which is exact.

The Hellfury / Hellspinner 'Boosted' and 'Augmented' upgrade steps are proven Soldier-only with level and skill requirements from items.ocp, but HOW you upgrade one (the tradeskill or quest) is not established here.
